items.question: What divine mother is praised as all-limb-beautiful and giver of all auspiciousness?
premises: The verse lists epithets of the goddess.
Sarvasaubhāgyadāyinī means giver of all auspiciousness.
items.inference: The goddess is the all-beautiful mother who grants all auspiciousness.
uncertainties: The exact theological referent beyond the epithet list is not specified.
items.plain_english: The all-limb-beautiful mother, giver of all auspiciousness.
